description: Land Acquisition - 05 Allotments and 51 Allotments of land in Thisawewa, Nuwaragam-palatha Central D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Amendment to the notice published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1969/41 of 02.06.2016 by Millaniya D/S Division
reasoning: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically detailing the acquisition of multiple land parcels for public purposes. It includes descriptions of land lots, their locations, extents, and claimant information, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
